metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods by weskao

plugins.name: prompt-toc
plugins.description: Markdown-style TOC pane of your prompts and reply headings; press one to scroll there. Prompts-only chip, time per prompt, follow-viewport underline, settings (Open pane on start, Show time; both on by default), /compact divider, `/prompt-toc <keyword>` filter, `/prompt-toc-export [path]` Markdown export

plugins.name: message-clock
plugins.description: Grok-style right-aligned clock on each sent prompt and each reply message

plugins.name: agent-toggle
plugins.description: Toggle skills, agents, rules, plugins and MCP servers from a pane (needs the agent-toggle CLI: uv tool install agent-toggle)

plugins.name: cache-sentinel
plugins.description: Warns above the prompt and in a toast before a /model, /effort or /fast switch or an idle gap re-writes the prompt cache, with tokens and est. USD; stops the first /model on a warm cache above MODEL_SWITCH_GUARD_TOKENS (a second within a minute goes through) and refuses a subagent Bash timeout over 4 min.

plugins.name: skill-step-progress
plugins.description: Live pane showing the current step and overall progress of this session's flows, one box per run: /commit (and any flow you add in ~/.claude/skill-step-progress/rules.json) by watching the commands it runs, and skills that write their own state to ~/.claude/usage-data/<skill>/<repo>/current.json
